original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    ssh_port: 22
    ssh_permit_root_login: "no"
    ssh_password_authentication: "no"
    ssh_pubkey_authentication: "yes"
    ssh_allow_users: []
    fail2ban_bantime: 3600
    fail2ban_findtime: 600
    fail2ban_maxretry: 5
    auditd_max_log_file: 8
    auditd_max_log_file_action: rotate
    auditd_space_left_action: email
    auditd_action_mail_acct: root
    auditd_admin_space_left_action: halt
    password_min_length: 14
    password_min_digit: 1
    password_min_upper: 1
    password_min_lower: 1
    password_min_other: 1
    password_remember: 5
    password_min_age: 1
    password_max_age: 90
    password_warn_age: 7

  tasks:
    - name: Update all packages
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "*"
        state: latest
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Install required packages
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - fail2ban
          - audit
          - audit-libs
          - libpwquality
          - openssh-server
        state: present

    - name: Configure SSH to disable root login and enforce key-based auth
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: "^{{ item.param }}"
        line: "{{ item.param }} {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { param: "PermitRootLogin", value: "{{ ssh_permit_root_login }}" }
        - { param: "PasswordAuthentication", value: "{{ ssh_password_authentication }}" }
        - { param: "PubkeyAuthentication", value: "{{ ssh_pubkey_authentication }}" }
        - { param: "Port", value: "{{ ssh_port }}" }
      notify: restart sshd

    - name: Set SSH AllowUsers if defined
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        line: "AllowUsers {{ ssh_allow_users | join(' ') }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes
      when: ssh_allow_users | length > 0
      notify: restart sshd

    - name: Configure password complexity via pwquality
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        regexp: "^{{ item.param }}"
        line: "{{ item.param }} = {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { param: "minlen", value: "{{ password_min_length }}" }
        - { param: "dcredit", value: "-{{ password_min_digit }}" }
        - { param: "ucredit", value: "-{{ password_min_upper }}" }
        - { param: "lcredit", value: "-{{ password_min_lower }}" }
        - { param: "ocredit", value: "-{{ password_min_other }}" }

    - name: Configure password aging policies in /etc/login.defs
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/login.defs
        regexp: "^{{ item.param }}"
        line: "{{ item.param }} {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { param: "PASS_MIN_DAYS", value: "{{ password_min_age }}" }
        - { param: "PASS_MAX_DAYS", value: "{{ password_max_age }}" }
        - { param: "PASS_WARN_AGE", value: "{{ password_warn_age }}" }

    - name: Configure password history in /etc/pam.d/system-auth
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/pam.d/system-auth
        regexp: '^password\s+sufficient\s+pam_unix\.so'
        line: "password    sufficient    pam_unix.so sha512 shadow nullok try_first_pass use_authtok remember={{ password_remember }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes

    - name: Configure fail2ban jail.local
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: jail.local.j2
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify: restart fail2ban

    - name: Enable and start fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        enabled: yes
        state: started

    - name: Configure auditd rules
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: audit.rules.j2
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/audit.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
      notify: restart auditd

    - name: Configure auditd.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: "^{{ item.param }}"
        line: "{{ item.param }} = {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { param: "max_log_file", value: "{{ auditd_max_log_file }}" }
        - { param: "max_log_file_action", value: "{{ auditd_max_log_file_action }}" }
        - { param: "space_left_action", value: "{{ auditd_space_left_action }}" }
        - { param: "action_mail_acct", value: "{{ auditd_action_mail_acct }}" }
        - { param: "admin_space_left_action", value: "{{ auditd_admin_space_left_action }}" }
      notify: restart auditd

    - name: Enable and start auditd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: auditd
        enabled: yes
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

    - name: restart fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted
